post.description: Creates the Plan with its Workouts, Exercises and sets in one transaction: nothing is saved unless all of it is. Every Exercise slug is checked against the Exercise Library first. By default the new Plan becomes the User's active one and every other Plan goes inactive. Not idempotent: a retried request can create a second Plan.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the Plan isn't valid; `unknown_exercises`: the Exercise Library has no Exercise for the slugs the message names. Nothing was saved

patch.description: Changes only the given fields. A new `measurement_system` first converts every stored height and weight of the User (the Profile's, every Plan's set targets and every Workout Session's weights) to the new system's units, then writes the given `height` and `weight` as they are, in the new system's units. Repeating the same request changes nothing more.
